title: 🚂 Daily Reward Hub & Fleet Depot Update! (v1.0.1)
message: We have introduced a redesigned Daily Reward Hub featuring real Express Charters and multi-stage fleet depot projects, plus major game performance polish!
points: 🎁 Daily VIP Express Dispatches: Dispatch up to 5 daily VIP charter trains to earn mystery cash bounties from $50K up to $1.0M.
🛠️ Assembly Rail Depot: Build and complete custom passenger and freight rakes step-by-step to earn large cash payouts.
⏰ Midnight Auto-Reset: Daily dispatches and assembly projects refresh automatically every day at 12:00 AM.
✨ Smooth Train Departures: Animated train departures across stations and depots with full audio effects.
🛡️ Stability & Progress Persistence: Instant cloud and local saves to ensure all player coins, unlocked platforms, and custom fleet trains remain secure.

title: 🎉 Welcome to American Rail Empire!
message: Step into the conductor booth and build America's greatest railroad network from the ground up!
points: 🚉 Central Station Management: Accept passenger and freight routes and manage platform departures in real time.
🏗️ Train Factory & Custom Rakes: Assemble custom locomotives, coaches, parcel vans, and heavy cargo haulers.
💰 Upgrades & Fleet Depot: Expand platform slots, unlock unique building styles, and customize track models.
